title: Synthetic Factory Eval Exclusion List v1
description: Shape of config/eval-exclusion/eval-denylist.json and config/eval-exclusion/do-not-train.json (#494). pipelines/eval_exclusion_lists.py is the authoritative loader: it also requires the file bytes to be the canonical exact-JSON form (two-space indent, sorted keys, trailing newline), every value list to be sorted, and every repo to be a canonical name that config/eval-exclusion/repo-aliases.json does not record as an old name. Values are matched whole, never by substring.

status.description: placeholder lists must be empty; they exclude nothing and say so in every compose summary.
